## Personality

Tabby harbors a personal aversion to large dwellings, preferring smaller spaces. Her primary desire is to see the Sphinx at least once before she dies.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Confidences P8](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0008), [v3 ch.Dawn P3](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0003)_

## History

Tabby Linden is a single woman who inherited her property, known as Tabby's Place, from her brother [Aaron](../character/aaron.md). She resides there alongside her niece, [Maria](../character/maria.md). When [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) visit her, Tabby agrees to rent her cottage to them for the upcoming school year.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P0](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0000), [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 ch.Place P32](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0032), [v3 ch.Place P38](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0038), [v3 ch.Place P59](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0059), [v4 CHAPTER 3 THE LAND OF DREAMS AMONG P55](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0055)_

## Quotes

> "Their age exceeds one hundred years, and their positions on both flanks of this hearth have remained unchanged from the time my brother Aaron fetched them from London half a century back. My brother Aaron was the namesake for Linden Avenue."
>
> — Tabby — [v3 ch.Place P25](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0025)

> "They are named Gog and Magog. Gog’s gaze goes toward the right, whereas Magog’s goes toward the left. Furthermore, I have a final query. It isn't a problem for you, I trust, if this house goes by the name of Tabby’s Place?"
>
> — Tabby — [v3 ch.Place P30](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0030)

> "Provided you pledge to take great care of the dogs, I am going to leave them in their current spots,"
>
> — Tabby — [v3 ch.Place P30](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0030)

> "It was my intention to remove that sign today."
>
> — Tabby — [v3 ch.Place P4](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0004)

> "Now, prior to treating our agreement as finalized, would you care to tour the residence and inspect everything?"
>
> — Tabby — [v3 ch.Place P32](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0032)

### [Maria](../character/maria.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/maria--tabby.md)

[Maria](../character/maria.md) is Tabby's niece, with whom she co-owns Tabby's Place. The two act as traveling companions who stay overseas together and plan to go to Egypt. They also arrange to rent their cottage to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Honora](../character/honora-hollis.md) for the school year.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Place P0](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0000), [v3 ch.Place P12](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0012), [v3 ch.Place P38](../source/v03-c10.md#nw-v03-c10-p0038), +3 more_
